development_release_policy: During development, heavy immutable research binaries live as uniquely named GitHub Release assets outside Git history. Actions runners and ChatGPT sandboxes download only the asset required by the current task, verify the recorded outer SHA-256 before extraction, and discard the local copy when done. Release assets are a development cache, not source authority and not the terminal production archive.
google_drive_policy: Google Drive is no longer the default store for heavy research binaries. It may be used only for lightweight/manual relay when a connector constraint requires it; do not put PDF/source/replay/runtime packs there by default.
postgres_policy: Do not transport a PostgreSQL cluster as session state. PostgreSQL remains the transactional write/ops engine and is rebuilt in an Action or other service-capable runtime when writes/leases/outbox semantics are required. Durable control-plane truth remains repository receipts plus immutable binary packs.
duckdb_policy: DuckDB is the portable read/replay materialization. Restore only the required Release asset, verify outer and inner SHA-256, install the pinned offline runtime only when the sandbox lacks a compatible DuckDB, and open research packs read-only.
terminal_archive_status: Deferred by explicit development-stage policy. GitHub Release is the temporary shared binary cache while the product is still being proven. After Longcycle is operational, move content-addressed raw source bytes, parser artifacts and portable replay packs to a dedicated server/object store without changing source authority or evidence semantics.
supersession_policy: Release assets are immutable and append-only by filename. Never clobber bytes behind an existing recorded filename. A successor pack gets a new unique filename and SHA-256; repository receipts/data-plane advance to it only after download-back verification.
